rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a concrete project with a defined goal and stages.

example.english: We will complete this project in three stages.
example.traditional: 呢個項目分三個階段完成。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 fan1 saam1 go3 gaai1 dyun6 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this when the focus is the plan or scheme behind the undertaking rather than the project as a work item.

example.english: The project plan is mainly about helping students find jobs.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃主要係幫學生搵工。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 bong1 hok6 saang1 wan2 gung1

rows.note: Use this for a public-housing building or home rather than a private development.

example.english: We finally got a public-housing flat through the housing project.
example.traditional: 我哋終於透過房屋計劃申請到一間公屋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 tau3 gwo3 fong4 uk1 gai3 waak6 san1 cing2 dou2 jat1 gaan1 gung1 uk1

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the public-housing estate or residential complex as a whole.

example.english: This estate was a major housing project back then.
example.traditional: 呢個屋邨係當年嘅大型房屋項目。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 uk1 cyun1 hai6 dong1 nin4 ge3 daai6 jing4 fong4 uk1 hong6 muk6
